# Igor Ganapolsky - Stripe Connect & Marketplace Payments Engineer

This site provides practical setup, troubleshooting, and paid diagnostic services for Mac AI agents, ResumeOS, and Stripe Connect marketplace payment work. For freelance work, the primary paid wedge is Stripe Connect / marketplace payments / refunds / webhooks / tax-boundary implementation, not generic AI/RAG.

## Key Offerings
- Free troubleshooting guides for common issues like "computer use plugin unavailable", Intel Mac problems, Claude Code crashes, etc.
- $499 Agent Safety Diagnostic: review a Codex, Claude, Chrome Computer Use, or OpenClaw workflow before it can post, apply, spend, delete, message clients, or ship production changes.
- $49 same-day triage: diagnose root cause from logs or issue.
- $499 Pilot: full installation, voice tuning, integrations for lead responder or agent setup, with refund guarantee if <3 conversions in 30 days.
- $497/month Retainer: ongoing tuning, new channels, performance reviews.
- Upwork services: Stripe Connect destination charges, platform-fee math, marketplace payout reconciliation, refund/webhook diagnosis, Checkout/subscription failures, Pretix payment plugins, and merchant-of-record/tax-boundary reviews. Fixed funded milestones only.

## Technology and Approach
- Uses Claude, OpenAI/GPT, Computer Use capabilities.
- ThumbGate for pre-action gating, safety, observability.
- Stripe Connect, marketplace payments, refunds, webhooks, and Pretix plugin implementation for revenue workflows.
- Stripe for payments (clear checkout links with UTM for tracking).
- Focus on production reliability, human-in-loop for high-risk actions, cost-aware routing.
- Private RAG data, bandits, execution as moat (not easily copied).
- Plausible for observability (visitors, bounce, goals).
